=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:310-665 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: run_plan_codex.sh is listed in `OWN_DIR_SCRIPTS` (tests/test_support_script_single_source.py:118), but it still has bare `scripts/` helper calls that match the new contract test's regex: `-f scripts/attempt_journal.py` (310), `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh` (348, 425), `-f scripts/evidence_pack.py` (363), `-f scripts/evidence_broker.py` (637) and `bash scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh` (661, 665).
  WHY: ci.yml runs tests/test_support_script_single_source.py, so `test_own_dir_scripts_have_no_bare_helper_calls[run_plan_codex.sh]` (tests/test_support_script_single_source.py:688-693) fails `assert not offenders` and the PR's own CI stays red. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER. Sonnet and minimax filed it under the test file, the others under run_plan_codex.sh.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:310-665 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The header (lines 3-8) says sibling helpers come from `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR`, but the helper calls at 310-311, 348, 363-405, 425, 637-645 and 661-665 still resolve cwd-relative `scripts/` paths in the issue checkout instead of the verified support bundle.
  WHY: The plan step has `GH_TOKEN` in its environment (plan.yml:2081), so target-branch Python, e.g. `stable` for heal issues, runs under main's YAML (the run 37406961564 trust boundary P2a set out to close). In consumer repos the helpers are absent, so the enabled journal, acceptance and evidence features are silently skipped. All four reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3395-3401 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The heal-regression gate still calls the bare `[ -f scripts/partial_delivery.py ] && ... python3 -I -B scripts/partial_delivery.py heal-regression` (line 3398), but the sibling heal-counterfactual call (about line 3300/3303) was switched to `"${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-scripts}/partial_delivery.py"`.
  WHY: In unified mode nothing is installed under the checkout's `scripts/`. In consumer repos the `-f` guard therefore fails, and with `WORKFLOW_HEAL_TREND_ENABLED=true` every heal plan is held with `heal_regression_check_unavailable`. In this repository the target-branch copy runs under main's YAML, which is the cross-ref execution P2a meant to remove. minimax adds that `test_no_bare_support_helper_calls[plan]` fails CI. minimax rated this BLOCKER; sonnet, luna and glm rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2358-2362, 3010 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The calls at plan.yml line 3010 (`python3 -B scripts/attempt_journal.py append`) and lines 2359/2362 (`python3 -I -B scripts/acceptance_check.py`) still run interpreter code from the checkout's `scripts/` in unified mode.
  WHY: This contradicts the P2a contract (stage_support_for_phase.sh header lines 19-23) that no helper runs from the issue checkout in unified mode. The kill switch cannot help, because these lines take the same path whether it is on or off.
- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:83-191 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unified per-phase lists for clarify, plan and implement omit the optional persistence helpers (`attempt_journal.py`, `gh_api_retry.py`, `acceptance_check.py`, `evidence_pack.py`, `evidence_broker.py`, `targeted_file_context.py`), and clarify's host-python list omits `evidence_pack.py`/`targeted_file_context.py`. The only install loops (implement.yml:1599, plan.yml:702/717/732/749, clarify.yml:538/550/563) now sit inside the legacy-only `support-scripts-legacy` regions.
  WHY: With the default `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED=true`, opt-in features (`PERSIST_JOURNAL_ENABLED`, `PERSIST_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED`, `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED`, `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_BROKER_ENABLED`) silently stop working or fail. The missing files are hit at implement.yml:2389/2977/6276/6493, plan.yml:2358-2362/3010, clarify.yml:1505/2400 and the run dir filled from `--list`. The failures are hidden by `-f`, `|| true` or `continue-on-error`. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1136-1200 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `_drain_retired_label` (default-on via `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED`) closes every open issue and PR that carries a retired label, including `ai:claude`, without checking whether the item is still live pipeline work.
  WHY: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py line 6250 says live standalone issues still carry a leftover `ai:claude` next to a phase label. The first weekly sync would close them and their open PRs as `not_planned`, up to 10 per run, and nothing reopens them. Deleting the label alone would be enough.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1140-1144 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 180 s drain deadline (`RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS`, line 40) is checked only before each item starts, so an in-flight item's marker GET(s), comment POST and close PATCH are unbounded (each call has a 120 s timeout, line 268).
  WHY: A slow API can push the job past the 5-minute workflow timeout before `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED` and `errors[]` are written, so the drain report for that run is lost. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16408, 16414, 16422 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In unified mode the script runs python3 code from the issue checkout (`scripts/`) instead of the trusted support bundle.
  WHY: This runs arbitrary target-branch Python with the orchestrator workflow's credentials, which violates the P2a trust boundary.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:"Stage workflow support files" step (unified branch) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: clarify calls `bash .codex-workflow-src/scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh clarify --host-python-dir ...` directly, without the read-only `--list` capability probe that plan.yml, implement.yml and orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml run first.
  WHY: An older support ref whose stager does not know `clarify` exits 2 under `set -euo pipefail`, which fails the clarify job instead of falling back to the legacy loop with a warning.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
